scanNote:
Photo File Section, UNIT 1 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

Betda 9 ta rangli surat bor — hammasi DUNYONING MASHHUR JOYLARI. Yozuv yo'q: o'quvchi rasmga qarab joy va mamlakat nomini o'zi aytishi kerak. Bu — Unit 1 ('Hi!') mavzusiga to'g'ri keladi: mamlakat va millat nomlari.

Rasmlar ostida nom bosilmagani uchun quyidagi ro'yxat suratlarni tanib olish asosida tuzildi.

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 1 - Look at the photos and say what they are and where they are.
exercises.instructionUz: 1-UNIT — Suratlarga qarang va ular nima ekanini, qayerdaligini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
BETDA 9 TA SURAT BOR — HAMMASI DUNYONING
MAShHUR JOYLARI.

⚠ Suratlar ostida NOM BOSILMAGAN. O'quvchi
rasmga qarab o'zi aytishi kerak — mashqning
maqsadi shu.


SURATLAR (chap ustundan boshlab):

  1) Giza piramidalari      — Misr
  2) Parfenon (Akropol)     — Yunoniston
  3) Sidney opera teatri    — Avstraliya
  4) Avliyo Vasiliy sobori  — Rossiya
  5) Toj Mahal             — Hindiston
  6) Oq uy                 — AQSh
  7) Eyfel minorasi        — Fransiya
  8) Big Ben               — Angliya
  9) Ozodlik haykali       — AQSh


⚠ NEGA AYNAN BU RASMLAR — UNIT 1 GA MOS:

  Unit 1 nomi — 'Hi!' (tanishuv).
  Uning asosiy mavzusi:
     'Where are you from?'
     'I'm from Egypt.'

  Word List'da (119-bet) Unit 1 da
  MAMLAKAT nomlari juda ko'p edi:
     Argentina, Brazil, Canada, China,
     Egypt, England, France, Greece,
     India, Italy, Japan, Mexico...

  Bu suratlar o'sha mamlakatlarni
  RASM orqali eslatadi.


⚠ IKKI SURAT BIR MAMLAKATDAN:

  Oq uy (Vashington) va Ozodlik haykali
  (Nyu-York) — ikkalasi ham AQShda.

  Demak 9 ta surat, 8 ta mamlakat.


GAP TUZISh QOLIPI:

  'This is the Eiffel Tower.
   It's in Paris, France.'

  'What is it? — It's Big Ben.'
  'Where is it? — It's in London.'


⚠ 'THE' QO'YILADIGAN NOMLAR:

  THE Eiffel Tower
  THE White House
  THE Statue of Liberty
  THE Taj Mahal
  THE Parthenon
  THE pyramids

  ⚠ 'the' YO'Q:
     Big Ben
     Sydney Opera House

  Qoida murakkab — bu nomlarni YODLASh
  kerak.


MAMLAKAT ↔ MILLAT (Unit 1 qoidasi):

  Egypt    → Egyptian   (misrlik)
  Greece   → Greek      (yunon)
  Australia → Australian (avstraliyalik)
  Russia   → Russian    (rus)
  India    → Indian     (hind)
  the USA  → American   (amerikalik)
  France   → French     (fransuz)
  England  → English    (ingliz)

  ⚠ Ko'pchiligiga '-AN' yoki '-ISH'
  qo'shiladi, lekin ISTISNOLAR bor
  (Greece → GREEK, France → FRENCH).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a pyramid   = piramida
  an opera house = opera teatri
  a cathedral = sobor
  a tower     = minora
  a statue    = haykal
  liberty     = ozodlik
  a landmark  = diqqatga sazovor joy

pairs.whyUz:
Word List'da 'pyramid' 15-unitda ham bor
(124-bet, sayohat mavzusi).

Egypt → EGYPTIAN (misrlik).

⚠ 'THE pyramids' — 'the' bilan.

Afinadagi Akropol tepasidagi qadimiy
ma'bad (miloddan avvalgi 5-asr).

Greece → GREEK (yunon).
⚠ ISTISNO: '-an' emas, 'GREEK'.

pairs.leftUz: Yelkan shaklidagi oq tomli bino, suv bo'yida
pairs.whyUz:
Tomi yelkanga o'xshaydi — dunyodagi eng
tanilgan binolardan biri.

Australia → AUSTRALIAN.
⚠ 'the' YO'Q: 'Sydney Opera House'.

Moskvadagi Qizil maydonda joylashgan.
Rang-barang piyozsimon gumbazlari bilan
tanilgan.

Russia → RUSSIAN (rus).
'a cathedral' = sobor (Word List, 119-bet).

Agra shahridagi oq marmar maqbara.
Oldidagi hovuzda aksi ko'rinadi.

India → INDIAN (hind).
⚠ 'THE Taj Mahal' — 'the' bilan.

pairs.leftUz: Oq ustunli bino, oldida favvora va gullar
pairs.whyUz:
Vashingtondagi AQSh prezidenti
qarorgohi.

the USA → AMERICAN (amerikalik).
⚠ 'THE White House' va 'THE USA' —
ikkalasi ham 'the' bilan.

Parijdagi temir minora (1889-yil).

France → FRENCH (fransuz).
⚠ ISTISNO: '-an' emas, 'FRENCH'.

⚠ 'THE Eiffel Tower' — 'the' bilan.

Londondagi parlament binosining soat
minorasi.

England → ENGLISH (ingliz).
⚠ 'the' YO'Q: shunchaki 'Big Ben'.

Word List 119-betda 'Big Ben' Unit 1 da.

pairs.right: the Statue of Liberty — the USA
pairs.whyUz:
Nyu-Yorkdagi haykal — Fransiya sovg'asi
(1886-yil).

⚠ 6-band bilan bir MAMLAKAT: Oq uy
Vashingtonda, Ozodlik haykali Nyu-Yorkda.
Demak 9 surat, 8 mamlakat.

'a statue' = haykal (Word List, 124-bet).
